en.title: United Flight UA-168 Diverts to Athens After Unusual Odour on Board
en.summary: A United Boeing 787-9 operating flight UA-168 from Tel Aviv to Newark diverted to Athens after the crew reported an unusual odour on board, landing safely on runway 03R about 40 minutes later.
body: A United Boeing 787-9, registration N24993, performing flight UA-168 from Tel Aviv to Newark with 230 passengers and 13 crew, was en route at FL320 about 170nm east-southeast of Athens when the crew decided to divert to Athens, reporting an unusual odour on board. The aircraft landed safely on Athens' runway 03R about 40 minutes later.
The airline reported the aircraft diverted to Athens to address an odour in the cabin. A replacement aircraft is being dispatched.

zh.title: 聯合航空波音787客機機艙異味，UA-168航班轉降雅典
zh.summary: 聯合航空一架波音787-9執行UA-168航班由特拉維夫飛往紐華克，機上230名乘客與13名機組人員，機組回報機艙出現異味後轉降雅典，約40分鐘後安全降落03R跑道。
body: 聯合航空一架波音787-9，註冊編號N24993，執行UA-168航班由特拉維夫飛往紐華克，機上載有230名乘客與13名機組人員，在雅典東南東方約170海里、FL320高度巡航時，機組回報機艙出現異味，決定轉降雅典。飛機約40分鐘後安全降落雅典03R跑道。
航空公司表示，飛機轉降雅典是為了處理機艙異味問題，並已調派替代飛機。
